title: Optional depth-like evidence stays non-authoritative
plainLanguage: Some pose systems provide a Z-like number that can hint whether a landmark is closer to or farther from the camera. Google explicitly describes its pose Z as experimental and not true 3D. That is the right level of trust for us.
purpose: Allow future depth hints without turning Corpus Pane into an accidental 3D solver.

rules.statement: If imported, depth-like values must be stored as optional provenance with source/model identity.
Depth-like values cannot verify hidden anatomy or determine draw order alone.
They may help rank perspective hypotheses when consistent with reviewed 2D evidence.

implementation.currentSupport: Current universal skeleton explicitly says depth is not inferred.
implementation.futureWork: Only add if it demonstrably reduces ambiguity in a controlled test.
